nodes.label: Frontend↔backend map
nodes.rationale: Grounded in 2026-07-23-cpd-mvp-architecture.md (K1–K3 · B1–B9 · surfaces), each capability carrying a build-state and tier, tags verified against real routes, 18 tables and functions.

nodes.label: The design artifact IS the real frontend
nodes.rationale: Every surface built: landing, organiser app ×8, practitioner app ×8, public event page single + multi-track, System sheet, and an Auth & onboarding context that closed the biggest lapse — the apps had no entry point. 38/38 navigation routes verified.

nodes.label: award_attendance_credit resolves identity at award time
nodes.rationale: Registration email → auth.users → active licence @ event body, all at award time. There is NO read-time query surfacing a registrant's licence status back to the organiser — that one missing view is what nearly every organiser eligibility feature in the mockup depends on.

nodes.label: Locked design values for the token migration
nodes.rationale: Universal 60px top bar, 248px sidebar, 24px content padding, 10.5px uppercase section labels, and the D glass-nav gradient — plus the one blue ramp (#1C3C94 primary / #0E79EC links / #4494BC borders / #6CAAEF tints) with semantic status colours kept off the brand ramp.
